_comment: Mutation testing for LethAL's OWN TypeScript. See docs/mutation-testing-ourselves.md for what
this can and cannot catch — it was added the day R175 proved it would NOT have caught R175,
and that limit is the first thing to understand before reading a score from it.
The `command` test runner is deliberate: it needs no third-party plugin. Stryker ships no
official Bun runner (stryker-js#4439, #5424) and the two community ones execute inside the test
process, which is a supply-chain decision this public repo should make on purpose rather than
by `bun add`. The cost is no per-test coverage analysis, so every mutant runs the whole command;
that is why `commandRunner.command` is narrowed to the suite covering the mutated files rather

No `packageManager` key: Stryker 10 accepts only npm/yarn/pnpm, and it is used solely to offer install hints for missing plugins. We install our own, so omitting it is correct rather than a workaround.
